arxiv-2307-06353.description: Abstract Some Seyfert galaxies are detected in high-energy gamma rays, but the mechanism and site of gamma-ray emission are unknown. We propose emission from stellar-mass BHs (sBHs) embedded in disks of active galactic nuclei (AGN) as their possible sources.

arxiv-2412-10607.title: Metric symmetry by design in general relativity
arxiv-2412-10607.creator: Viktor T. Toth
arxiv-2412-10607.description: Abstract The usual derivation of Einstein’s field equations from the Einstein–Hilbert action is performed by silently assuming the metric tensor’s symmetric character. If this symmetry is not assumed, the result is a new theory, such as Einstein’s attempted Unified Field Theory or Moffat’s Nonsymmetric Gravitational Theory.
